mapper.select: select count(1) from (select ENTRUST_ID from WFL_IBU_QUOTE_BOND2 where ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId} union all select ENTRUST_ID from WFL_IBU_QUOTE_CREP where ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId} union all select ENTRUST_ID from IBU_QUOTE_BOND where ENTRUST_ID= #{entrustId} and TRADE_STATUS not in ('06','08') union all select ENTRUST_ID from IBU_QUOTE_CREP where ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId} and TRADE_STATUS not in ('06','08') union all select ENTRUST_ID from WFL_REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL where ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId})
